nodes.title: Male Circumcision
nodes.content: Surgical excision of the male foreskin

nodes.title: Keratinization
nodes.content: Drying and desensitization due to constant exposure

nodes.title: Friction
nodes.content: Increased chafing without gliding mechanism

nodes.title: Scar Line
nodes.content: Cicatrix where layers are surgically sutured

nodes.title: Loss of Sensitivity
nodes.content: Reduction in fine touch perception due to tissue removal

nodes.title: Meatal Stenosis
nodes.content: Pathological narrowing of the urethral opening due to friction/ammonia exposure

nodes.title: Skin Bridges
nodes.content: Abnormal wound healing adhering shaft skin to the corona/glans

nodes.title: Tight Erections
nodes.content: Pain or curvature caused by insufficient mobile skin post-surgery

nodes.title: Simplified Hygiene
nodes.content: Easier washing routine

nodes.title: Female Genital Cutting (FGM/C)
nodes.content: Non-medical ritual removal of some or all of the external female genitalia

nodes.title: FGM Type 1 (Clitoridectomy)
nodes.content: Partial or total removal of the clitoris and/or the prepuce (clitoral hood).

nodes.title: Type 1a
nodes.content: Removal of the clitoral hood or prepuce only.

nodes.title: Type 1b
nodes.content: Removal of the clitoris with the prepuce.

nodes.title: FGM Type 2 (Excision)
nodes.content: Partial or total removal of the clitoris and the labia minora.

nodes.title: Type 2a
nodes.content: Removal of the labia minora only.

nodes.title: Type 2b
nodes.content: Partial or total removal of the clitoris and the labia minora.

nodes.title: Type 2c
nodes.content: Partial or total removal of the clitoris, the labia minora, and the labia majora.

nodes.title: FGM Type 3 (Infibulation)
nodes.content: Narrowing of the vaginal orifice with creation of a covering seal by cutting and appositioning the labia.

nodes.title: FGM Type 4
nodes.content: All other harmful procedures for non-medical purposes (pricking, piercing, incising, scraping, cauterizing).

nodes.title: Loss of Sensitivity
nodes.content: Drastic reduction or complete loss of primary sexual responsiveness due to glans excision.

nodes.title: Clitoral Neuroma
nodes.content: Painful bundled nerve endings trapped in scar tissue following clitoral excision.

nodes.title: Dyspareunia
nodes.content: Severe pain during sexual intercourse due to rigid scarring and narrowed vaginal introitus.

nodes.title: Urinary & Menstrual Obstruction
nodes.content: Retention of urine and menses causing chronic pelvic pain, hematocolpos, and recurrent severe infections.

nodes.title: Obstetric Complications
nodes.content: Significantly increased risk of severe tearing, prolonged labor, hemorrhage, and neonatal complications.

nodes.title: Glans Protection
nodes.content: Maintains the glans as an internal, moist mucosal organ, preventing keratinization.

nodes.title: Friction Reduction
nodes.content: The natural gliding mechanism reduces friction and chafing during intercourse.

nodes.title: Preserved Sensitivity
nodes.content: Maintenance of the full complement of specialized mechanoreceptors.

nodes.title: Natural Lubrication
nodes.content: Production of natural emollients that keep the genital structures moisturized.

nodes.title: Obstetric Safety
nodes.content: Intact, elastic vulvar and perineal tissues can stretch naturally during childbirth.

nodes.title: Nerve Endings
nodes.content: High density sensory receptors

nodes.title: Meissner Corpuscles
nodes.content: Mechanoreceptors highly sensitive to light touch

nodes.content: Male-specific areas highly sensitive to sexual stimulation

nodes.title: Female Erogenous Zones
nodes.content: Female-specific areas highly sensitive to sexual stimulation

nodes.title: Shared Sexual Pleasure
nodes.content: Neurological responses to sexual stimulation common to all humans

nodes.title: Male Sexual Pleasure
nodes.content: Physiological and neurological responses to sexual stimulation in males

nodes.title: Female Sexual Pleasure
nodes.content: Physiological and neurological responses to sexual stimulation in females

nodes.title: Shared Climax
nodes.content: Shared physiological peak of sexual arousal and the threshold of inevitability.

nodes.title: Male Climax
nodes.content: The peak of sexual arousal in males, often marked by the sensation of ejaculatory inevitability.

nodes.title: Female Climax
nodes.content: The peak of sexual arousal in females, immediately preceding and triggering orgasmic contractions.

nodes.title: Oxytocin & Dopamine
nodes.content: Brain chemicals flooded during arousal and climax causing euphoria and bonding

nodes.title: Immunological Defense
nodes.content: Mucosal immunity system protecting against pathogens

nodes.title: Smegma
nodes.content: Natural emollient and antibacterial lubricant produced in genital folds

nodes.title: Female Orgasm
nodes.content: Full orgasm experience in biological females.

nodes.title: Male Orgasm
nodes.content: Full orgasm experience in biological males.

nodes.title: Shared Orgasm
nodes.content: Orgasm types and experiences possible across all genders.

nodes.title: Clitoral Orgasm
nodes.content: Orgasm primarily triggered by direct or indirect clitoral stimulation

nodes.title: Vaginal Orgasm
nodes.content: Orgasm triggered by internal vaginal stimulation

nodes.title: Blended Orgasm
nodes.content: Simultaneous clitoral and vaginal/cervical orgasm

nodes.title: Cervical Orgasm
nodes.content: Deep, full-body orgasm from stimulation of the cervix

nodes.title: Female Ejaculation Orgasm
nodes.content: Orgasm accompanied by expulsion of fluid from the Skene's glands

nodes.title: Prostatic Orgasm
nodes.content: Deep, wave-like orgasm from prostate (P-spot) stimulation

nodes.title: Ejaculatory Orgasm
nodes.content: Male orgasm accompanied by rhythmic contractions and expulsion of semen

nodes.title: Dry Orgasm (Non-Ejaculatory Orgasm)
nodes.content: Full orgasmic contractions and intense pleasure without semen expulsion

nodes.title: Ejaculation Without Orgasm
nodes.content: Physical expulsion of semen without the pleasurable orgasmic peak

nodes.title: Ejaculation
nodes.content: Release of semen during male orgasm

nodes.title: Anal Orgasm
nodes.content: Orgasm achieved through anal and rectal stimulation, possible in all genders

nodes.title: Multiple Orgasm
nodes.content: Successive orgasms with minimal or no refractory period.

nodes.title: Refractory Period
nodes.content: Recovery phase after orgasm in which further sexual stimulation does not easily produce another climax

nodes.title: Brain
nodes.content: Central organ of the nervous system; processes all sexual pleasure, arousal, and orgasm signals

nodes.title: Pudendal Nerve
nodes.content: Major nerve supplying the perineum, genitals, and pelvic floor; carries most sexual sensation

nodes.title: Pelvic Nerves
nodes.content: Autonomic and somatic nerves (hypogastric, pelvic splanchnic) that control erection, lubrication, and orgasm

nodes.title: Penile Erection
nodes.content: Vasocongestion and engorgement of penile erectile tissue triggered by nitric oxide and pelvic nerves

nodes.title: Vaginal Lubrication
nodes.content: Transudation of plasma fluid through vaginal walls plus Bartholin and Skene secretions during arousal

nodes.title: Sexual Arousal
nodes.content: Physiological and psychological state of heightened sexual readiness common to all humans

nodes.title: Vasocongestion
nodes.content: Increased blood flow to genital tissues producing swelling, erection, and lubrication

nodes.title: Seminal Fluid
nodes.content: Mixture of sperm and glandular secretions that forms semen; provides nourishment, motility, and pH buffering

nodes.title: Pre-ejaculate
nodes.content: Clear Cowper's gland fluid that neutralizes urethral acidity and provides initial lubrication

nodes.title: Skin and Mucosa
nodes.content: Outer protective layer and inner moist linings; sensitivity varies dramatically between keratinized and mucosal tissue

nodes.title: Endocrine System
nodes.content: Hormones (testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, oxytocin) that regulate libido, arousal, and orgasm

nodes.title: Sexual Response Cycle
nodes.content: Excitement → Plateau → Orgasm → Resolution (Masters & Johnson model, applies to all genders)

nodes.title: Myotonia
nodes.content: Increased muscle tension throughout the body during the plateau phase

nodes.title: Plateau Phase
nodes.content: Sustained high arousal with maximal vasocongestion and rhythmic breathing

nodes.title: Male Refractory Period
nodes.content: Typical 15–30 minutes (longer with age) during which another erection/orgasm is difficult

nodes.title: Female Refractory Period
nodes.content: Often minimal or absent, enabling multiple orgasms in quick succession

nodes.title: Clitoral Erection
nodes.content: Engorgement of the clitoral body, crura, and vestibular bulbs during arousal
